roads.name: Park Road 5
words: Properly twisty: 41 curves in 6.5 miles, about 6 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 2,773 to 3,441 ft, with 1,160 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 30 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.25 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Park Road 5 Alternate
words: Sweeping and steady: 12 curves in 2.6 miles.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 2,768 to 2,877 ft, with 290 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 30 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.16 g.

roads.name: State Park Road
words: Properly twisty: 29 curves in 5.7 miles, about 5 a mile.
From 2,331 to 2,640 ft, with 897 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.76 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
